summary: The Form 6-K reports MDA Space Ltd.'s (TSX, NYSE) May 7, 2026 annual general meeting results, including election of seven directors, appointment of KPMG LLP as auditor, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. Directors were elected with high support (91-99% for), auditor appointment received 99.89% for, and say-on-pay passed 94.47% for. This is a routine governance filing, not a special situation, as no forced management change, acquisition, or restructuring is disclosed. It confirms standard shareholder approval with no material event beyond meeting results.
